# Press summary

The city publishes ridership figures twice a year. Here is a short summary for journalists who follow local buses and trains.

| Route | Trips (million) | Share of all trips |
|---|---:|---:|
| Route 12 | 2.9 | 19% |
| Route 7 | 2.4 | 16% |
| Route 3 | 1.8 | 12% |

## Conclusion
Route 12 is the busiest route in the network.

Questions can be sent to the press office. Photos of the bus depot are available on request.
